Class ChaosPresets

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.api.ChaosPresets
public final class ChaosPresets extends Object
Ready-made scenarios for the faults production systems actually meet: a full or failing disk, a refused or slow peer, packet loss, a DNS outage, a clock jump, exhausted descriptors or threads. Each is the JVM counterpart of a rule of the native chaos libraries.

Every preset returns a prefilled ChaosScenario.Builder — id, description, selector, effect, and the tag preset=<name> — so the scope, the activation policy, the precedence and further tags stay the caller's. The id is the preset's (the builder cannot change it): to run a preset twice, stop the first activation or activate the second in another scope: 

chaos.activate(
    ChaosPresets.diskFull("/var/lib/app")
        .activationPolicy(ActivationPolicy.builder().probability(0.1).build())
        .build());
